newsitem.title: CHINA: China end-Sept forex reserves $95 bln - newspaper.
newsitem.headline: China end-Sept forex reserves $95 bln - newspaper.

text.p: China's foreign exchange reserves rose to $95.0 billion at the end of September, the China Securities newspaper on Saturday quoted central bank governor Dai Xianglong as saying.

China's foreign exchange reserves increased by about $20.0 billion in the first three quarters of 1996 compared with $22.0 billion in the whole of 1995, the newspaper said. It gave no further details.
Dai said reserves stood at $93.0 billion at the end of August.
Officials have said China's foreign exchange reserves could climb to nearly $100 billion by the end of this year.
